body.statement: There are constants \(C_1,c_0,\kappa>0\) such that \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\mathbb E_P\lVert\widehat\tau-\tau(P)\rVert^2\leq C_1L_n/n\) and \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}(n/L_n)\inf_{\widetilde\tau_n}\sup_{P\in\mathcal N_n(P_0,\kappa)}\mathbb E_P\lVert\widetilde\tau_n-\tau(P)\rVert^2\geq c_0\). The lower bound is witnessed by def:green-local-alternatives and lem:green-local-alternatives, for which \(\log(1/\varepsilon_n)=(\eta/a_h)L_n\).
body.justification: The Green-aligned two-point converse certifies that the logarithmic critical variance is information-theoretic rather than a defect of the chosen smoother.
body.gap: HutterRigollet2021Minimax and ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2024Plugin study global one-map loss; their dimension-two lower bound does not produce the pointwise logarithm or a nested four-cell local experiment.
body.consumer: The rate certificate tells users that reducing the Card--Krueger arrow uncertainty requires more information or structure, not merely a different smooth plug-in implementation.
